verification_policy: These records are sourced from the structured research corpus and remain partially_verified until acquisition, mechanics, and CaC availability are independently reconciled against canonical in-game evidence.

records.name: Bending Kamehameha
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop after completing the Saiyan Threat story saga; research corpus lists 1,200 Zeni. Also listed in TP Medal Shop rotations.
records.source_quest_or_shop: Skill Shop after Saiyan Threat; TP Medal Shop rotations
records.skill_description: A fast Kamehameha whose follow-up input bends the beam toward the locked-on opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: The structured source describes a straight initial beam followed by an additional input that makes the projectile chase the target. The source reports approximately 10% community-measured damage and emphasizes fast startup and strong tracking. Exact current frame data is not independently verified.
records.combo_notes: The tracking follow-up can extend combo routes and catch movement after a straight-beam cast would miss.
records.pve_notes: Useful as a low-cost ranged attack against mobile AI opponents and for finishing knockback routes.
records.pvp_notes: The bending input improves coverage against lateral movement and retreating opponents; exact current tracking behavior should be treated as partially verified.

records.name: Perfect Shot
records.unlock_method: Cell (Perfect) Instructor Quest 3; research corpus identifies it as a mentor-training reward and not a shop skill.
records.skill_description: A delayed volley of powerful Ki Blasts that can continue hitting after the caster regains control.
records.mechanics_notes: The source describes a noticeable startup followed by a multi-hit fingertip volley with mild cone tracking. It reports roughly nine hits and lingering hit activity after the caster's recovery, allowing follow-up actions. Damage and exact timing are community observations rather than official multipliers.
records.combo_notes: Works best after knockback or hard knockdown setups that give the startup time to complete; lingering hits can support follow-up attacks.
records.pve_notes: The lingering projectile behavior can maintain pressure on AI enemies while the player prepares another action.
records.pvp_notes: The delayed activation creates setup potential but is vulnerable to interruption when used raw; exact current exceptions and frame windows remain unverified.

records.name: Arm Crash
records.unlock_method: Nappa Instructor Quest 2; research corpus identifies it as a mentor-training reward and not a shop skill.
records.skill_description: A forward rushing Strike attack that breaks an opponent's guard, with increased travel distance when charged.
records.mechanics_notes: The structured source identifies an instant guard-break property and a charge that increases travel distance to roughly 1.5 times the normal route. It reports approximately 22% uncharged and 26% charged damage in community testing; those figures are not treated as official values.
records.combo_notes: The rushing attack can close distance and end strings with a knockdown; the charged version extends the range of the same approach.
records.pve_notes: Useful for breaking defensive AI behavior and closing distance, particularly when enemies are blocking.
records.pvp_notes: The guard-break property gives it a clear role against blocking opponents, while its startup and single-hit nature leave it vulnerable to reads and interruption.

records.name: Emperor's Death Beam
records.unlock_method: TP Medal Shop; research corpus lists 25 TP Medals in regular rotation.
records.skill_description: A sustained fingertip beam attack whose number of shots scales with the Ki stored when activated.
records.mechanics_notes: The source ties the number of beams directly to stored Ki and describes a minimum cost around 400 Ki. The full-gauge version produces a long volley; exact current beam count and damage scaling are not independently reconciled here.
records.combo_notes: Best suited to confirms that leave the opponent unable to escape the sustained volley; exact combo routes depend on target state.
records.pve_notes: The scalable volley provides a substantial Ki dump against enemies that can be held in place, while the resource cost makes setup important.
records.pvp_notes: Requires a reliable opening because opponents can escape or punish poor setup; exact current tracking and escape windows remain partially verified.

records.name: Justice Blade
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 152 "Dyspo's Wanted Man"; research corpus reports a 40% Ultimate Finish bonus reward slot.
records.skill_description: A rapid energy-blade Strike that deals additional damage on hit and enables a follow-up Ultimate Attack.
records.mechanics_notes: The source describes an approximately 11-hit blade sequence followed by a pose that deals additional damage and unlocks a follow-up Ultimate. Community damage measurements are retained as measurements rather than official values.
records.combo_notes: A successful hit creates the move's Ultimate-follow-up state, making it primarily useful after a reliable confirm or combo route.
records.pve_notes: Can convert a successful close-range hit into an Ultimate sequence against enemies that remain vulnerable through the pose.
records.pvp_notes: The Ultimate-follow-up property creates a strong conversion opportunity after a confirmed hit, but opponents retain counterplay against the initial approach; exact current timing is not independently verified.
